extractions.value: Anti-amphiphysin antibody related eye movement disorder heralding the onset of SPS; ophthalmoplegia with restricted horizontal pursuit and saccadic eye movements, intact vertical eye movements, no nystagmus or diplopia; patient had breast cancer; prolonged inpatient admission of 8 months; stiffness only resolved after starting aggressive chemotherapy for the underlying carcinoma; only partial response to immunoglobulins and plasma exchange.
extractions.quote: We report a case of an anti-amphiphysin antibody related eye movement disorder heralding the onset of SPS.
